_comment: Offline fixture for scripts/check-sync-nanogpt-model-updates.mjs. Real NanoGPT /api/updates cards (ids preserved) plus a couple of synthetic edge cases. Not a live fetch.

updates.title: MiniMax H3 Max
updates.text: [MiniMax H3 Max](https://nano-gpt.com/media?mode=video&model=minimax%2Fh3-max) is now available! Create videos from a text prompt, animate a starting image, or guide a controlled transition with optional first and last frames. One unified model automatically switches between text-to-video and image-to-video based on your inputs.

updates.title: Claw and Hermes Now Use GLM 5.3
updates.text: [Claw High](https://nano-gpt.com/conversation?model=claw-high), [Claw Medium](https://nano-gpt.com/conversation?model=claw-medium), [Claw Low](https://nano-gpt.com/conversation?model=claw-low), [Hermes High](https://nano-gpt.com/conversation?model=hermes-high), [Hermes Medium](https://nano-gpt.com/conversation?model=hermes-medium), and [Hermes Low](https://nano-gpt.com/conversation?model=hermes-low) now use GLM 5.3 by default. The tier names and legacy AutoClaw aliases remain available for compatibility, but currently use the same model: a strong fit for long-horizon coding, agent workflows, tool use, structured output, and complex engineering tasks.

updates.title: Ling and Ring 2.6 Retired
updates.text: Ling 2.6 Flash, Ling 2.6 1T, and Ring 2.6 1T have been retired because they are no longer available from any provider. Existing conversations remain in your history, but new requests using these model IDs will return a model-unavailable response. For current InclusionAI models, try Ling 3.0 Flash or Ling 3.0 Tiny.

updates.title: CharacterVault official site migration
updates.text: CharacterVault now has an official home at [charactervault.app](https://charactervault.app/), with the app at [vault.charactervault.app](https://vault.charactervault.app/) and documentation at [vault.charactervault.app/docs](https://vault.charactervault.app/docs/). The previous GitHub Pages app is deprecated, frozen at version 1.4.0, and will not receive future updates.

updates.title: Wan 3.0 Prime
updates.text: [Wan 3.0 Prime](https://nano-gpt.com/media?mode=video&model=alibaba%2Fwan-3.0-prime) is now available! Create cinematic videos from a text prompt, animate a start image with optional end-frame guidance, or use images, videos, and audio as references to preserve characters, products, voices, motion, and visual style across a shot. One unified model automatically chooses the right generation mode from your inputs and can generate synchronized audio with the finished clip.

updates.title: MiniMax Music 3
updates.text: [MiniMax Music 3](https://nano-gpt.com/media?mode=audio&model=minimax%2Fmusic-3) is now available! Create complete songs from a detailed description and structured lyrics, switch to instrumental-only mode, and choose the output bitrate and sample rate.

updates.title: Recraft V4 Style Models
updates.text: [Recraft V4 Style](https://nano-gpt.com/media?mode=image&model=recraft-ai%2Frecraft-v4-style%2Ftext-to-image) and [Recraft V4 Style Pro](https://nano-gpt.com/media?mode=image&model=recraft-ai%2Frecraft-v4-style-pro%2Ftext-to-image) are now available for consistent visual production. Upload up to 10 references or reuse a saved Recraft style ID to carry the same art direction across brand assets, campaigns, illustrations, and design systems.

updates.title: Qwen3.8 Flash
updates.text: [Qwen3.8 Flash](https://nano-gpt.com/conversation?model=alibaba%2Fqwen3.8-flash) is now available and included in the subscription at 1x included-input usage! This fast multimodal reasoning model supports text, images, and video with a million-token context window.

updates.title: NanoGPT API Now Available on Tor
updates.text: The NanoGPT text API is now available as a Tor Onion service. [View the Onion API address and setup instructions](https://nano-gpt.com/api#onion).

updates.title: Kimi K3 Private Mode Pricing Update
updates.text: Unfortunately, the upstream provider has increased the price for Kimi K3 Private Mode. We have adjusted NanoGPT's pricing accordingly to reflect the new upstream cost.
